# link11waap_content_filter_rules (Data Source)

Lists all content filter rules in a configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Content Filter Rules Data Source

data "link11waap_config" "main" {}

data "link11waap_content_filter_rules" "all" {
  config_id = data.link11waap_config.main.id
}

output "content_filter_rules" {
  value = data.link11waap_content_filter_rules.all.content_filter_rules
}

output "content_filter_rule_names" {
  value = [for rule in data.link11waap_content_filter_rules.all.content_filter_rules : rule.name]
}

output "high_risk_rules" {
  value = [for rule in data.link11waap_content_filter_rules.all.content_filter_rules : rule if rule.risk >= 4]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config_id` (String) Configuration ID.

### Read-Only

- `content_filter_rules` (Attributes List) List of content filter rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content_filter_rules))

<a id="nestedatt--content_filter_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content_filter_rules`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category of the rule.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier.
- `msg` (String) Log message for this rule.
- `name` (String) Name of the rule.
- `operand` (String) Matching domain(s) regex.
- `risk` (Number) Risk level (1-5).
- `subcategory` (String) Subcategory of the rule.
- `tags` (List of String) List of tags.
